description: This file defines a PHP trait 'TaxonomyIndexDepthQueryTrait' used within Drupal's taxonomy module. It builds and adds a depth-based subquery join to a database query for hierarchical taxonomy terms, optimizing hierarchical searches in Drupal views.

methods.name: addSubQueryJoin
methods.description: Builds a depth-based subquery and adds it as a join to the main query, handling hierarchy traversal based on depth options.
